scope: Unbranded informational civic questions; targets are for observer analysis, never inserted into the prompts.

prompts.prompt: What does the Macon-Bibb County Board of Elections do, and where can I find its official contact information? Cite sources.
prompts.review_rubric: Check board role, official contact page, address, phone, hours and dates against current official sources; flag unsupported detail.

prompts.prompt: What is the difference between the Macon-Bibb County Board of Tax Assessors and Tax Commissioner? Cite official sources.
prompts.review_rubric: Distinguish valuation/assessment from billing/collection; no personalized tax advice or invented deadlines.

prompts.prompt: What is the difference between apportionment and redistricting, and where can I find Macon-Bibb commission district maps? Cite sources.
prompts.review_rubric: Distinguish seat allocation from boundary drawing; official current maps, scope/date and uncertainty; no address-based district guess.
